column3: “Like one person” is rendered “as one man,” and “the open space” as “the square.” “Said to” is rendered “asked,” and “commanded” as “had given to.”
“From man and unto woman” is rendered “of men, women,” and “every one who understood to listen” as “all who could listen with understanding.”
“From the light” is rendered “from early morning,” and “the ears of all the people were to the book” as “all the people were attentive to the book.”
“A high platform of wood” is rendered “a wooden podium,” and “for the matter” as “for the purpose.”
“In the raising of their hands” is rendered “while lifting up their hands.”
“Were causing … to understand the law” is rendered “explained the law,” and “at their place” as “remained in their place.”
“Making clear” is rendered “translating”; it may mean “clearly,” and the meaning is uncertain. NASB supplies “so that.”
“Who were causing … to understand” is rendered “who taught.”
“Fat foods” is rendered “of the fat,” and “sweet things” as “of the sweet.” “Our lords” is rendered “our Lord,” and “refuge” as “strength.”
“Making quiet” is rendered “calmed,” and “hush” as “Be still.”
“To make great joy” is rendered “to celebrate a great festival.”
“They gathered” is rendered “were gathered,” and “leaders of the fathers” as “heads of fathers' households.”
“By the hand of Moses” is rendered “through Moses.”
“That they will make proclamation” is rendered “So they proclaimed.” “Leaves” is rendered “branches,” and “trees of oil” as “wild olive.” NASB supplies “other.”
“Jeshua” is rendered “Joshua,” and “very great joy” as “great rejoicing.” NASB adds “indeed.”
“A day in a day” is rendered “daily,” and “an assembly” as “a solemn assembly.”
